description: This header file defines utility classes and functions for testing within the ocudu project, including custom log sinks, test delimiters, test objects for move and copy semantics, a random number generator for tests, and formatting support.

classes.name: log_sink_spy
classes.description: A custom log sink that counts error and warning log entries.

classes.name: log_sink_message_spy
classes.description: A custom log sink that stores log entries and allows checking for specific messages.

classes.name: test_delimit_logger
classes.description: A utility class that outputs delimiters around test logs for clarity.

classes.name: moveonly_test_object
classes.description: A test object to verify move semantics, with internal object count tracking.

classes.name: copyonly_test_object
classes.description: A test object to verify copy semantics, with internal object count tracking.

classes.name: nondefault_ctor_test_object
classes.description: A simple test object with a non-default constructor.

classes.name: test_rgen
classes.description: A class providing a reproducible pseudo-random number generator for unit tests.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the identifier name of the custom sink.

methods.name: get_error_counter
methods.description: Returns the count of error log entries.

methods.name: get_warning_counter
methods.description: Returns the count of warning log entries.

methods.name: reset_counters
methods.description: Resets error and warning counters to zero.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Processes a log buffer, updating error/warning counts.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes the log sink.

methods.name: has_message
methods.description: Checks if a specific message exists in the stored log entries.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears all stored log entries.

methods.name: test_delimit_logger
methods.description: Outputs delimiters for test start/end with test name.

methods.name: has_value
methods.description: Checks if the object contains a value.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the stored integer value.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison for moveonly_test_object.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison for moveonly_test_object.

methods.name: object_count
methods.description: Returns the current count of moveonly_test_object instances.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the stored integer value in copyonly_test_object.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison for copyonly_test_object.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison for copyonly_test_object.

methods.name: object_count
methods.description: Returns the current count of copyonly_test_object instances.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the value stored in nondefault_ctor_test_object.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the singleton test pseudo-random generator.

methods.name: set_seed
methods.description: Sets the seed for the test pseudo-random generator.

methods.name: uniform_int
methods.description: Generates a uniform random integer within bounds.

methods.name: bernoulli
methods.description: Performs a Bernoulli trial with probability p.

methods.name: normal_dist
methods.description: Generates a normally distributed random number.

methods.name: random_vector
methods.description: Creates a vector of random integers of specified size.
